summary: Content Library Admin CMS — Phase A backend regression: 19/19 PASSED (100%). Version stamp confirmed as build_version=2026.06.17.004 / build_tag=v3.27-content-library-cms-phaseA. All review-request acceptance items verified: GET /api/content-library/modules returns exactly 7 modules with tenses_feels first and block counts; schema discovery returns 12-field schema for tenses_feels (title required, tense/polarity/category/healing_feeling are select fields with options) and 3-field generic schema for goals_feels; POST /api/content-library/seed/tenses_feels is idempotent (second call inserted=0, force=true updated=12, total_seed_entries=12); admin list returns ≥12 seeded entries with all 12 expected keys (clinging…heartbroken) sorted by order; full CRUD works — POST creates with version=1, duplicate (module,key,locale) returns 409, PUT bumps version to 2 and updates title, DELETE soft-deletes (active=false excluded from active=true filter); render endpoint serves 12 blocks for locale=en and correctly falls back to en when locale=hi has no blocks; auth gating returns 401/403 on /api/content-library and /api/content-library/seed/tenses_feels without auth; ACM v2 regression (geo, resolver-config, trial-payments) still healthy. Frontend not tested (backend-only request).
action_items: None — all 16 acceptance items from the review request pass. Phase A backend CMS is ready for frontend integration testing on /admin/content-library.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/content_library.py is clean and self-contained (~390 lines, well under the 700-line threshold). SUPPORTED_MODULES list is hard-coded — fine for Phase A but consider moving to DB/config when more modules join.

POST /api/content-library returns the inserted doc directly but HTTP status is 200 (FastAPI default) rather than 201; spec wording 'creates and returns id' is satisfied (id present in body). Cosmetic only.

DEFAULT_SEED uses 12 emotion entries which mirrors src/data/tensesFeelsContent.ts; ensure_indexes() creates the (module,key,locale) unique index — verified by duplicate POST returning 409 as expected.
Render endpoint groups by key and merges locale preference (requested locale > en fallback). The merge logic is O(n) and handles the spec's locale-fallback requirement correctly.
Admin gate via _require_admin(user) consistently applied on every write endpoint and on the (admin-only) list endpoint; render & modules & schema are public as designed.
Soft-delete is implemented via {active: False} update — matches spec; DELETE returns {ok: true, deactivated_id} which is informative.

The 12 default tenses_feels seed entries are now present in content_blocks collection (created via /seed/tenses_feels). All seed entries have version=2 after the force=true test ran.
